svg.title: 16 · Three Layer KMP Domain
svg.desc: Three Layer KMP Domain. The domain layer is shared. Presentation and data remain app-owned layers; presentation contains UI plus ViewModel. Solid arrows show calls or dependencies.

g.text: KMP ARCHITECTURE · THREE LAYER KMP · DEPENDENCY FLOW
